environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on an EC2 instance with a public-facing Application Load Balancer. The ALB terminates TLS and forwards traffic to port 3000. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The jsonwebtoken library version is 8.5.1. The RSA public key is a standard 2048-bit PEM file at /etc/app/keys/rsa_public.pem. No network restrictions on who can reach the ALB.
